title: Image generation: prompt, style and limits

videos.script: So far, models have read pictures. Now they draw them. {{title}} An image generator starts from noise. It takes it away, step by step, until a picture is left that fits your words. {{noise}} That has two consequences. The same prompt gives a different picture every time. And the words are a request, not an instruction. {{request}} So learning to prompt an image model is not learning magic phrases. It is learning to change one thing and look again. {{axes}} You will build a banner prompt for Marginalia's newsletter, in named parts. Then you will vary them one at a time. {{grid}} A warning about this lab. No image generator runs here. The pictures that come back are cards that say so. {{cards}} What is real is the method, the requests and the log. Those are the parts you keep when the model changes. {{method}} And the model will change. This is the fastest-ageing lesson in the course. {{end}}
